veranderings.rede: 'rondom hom' is the more natural and clearer way to say 'the people around him'; bare 'om hom' reads stiffly.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy met 'n groot gevoel kan doen
veranderings.voor: sê vir jouself jy is kwaad
veranderings.na: sê vir jouself dat jy kwaad is
veranderings.rede: Indirect speech reads more correctly and clearly at Grade 5 with 'dat' and the verb at the end.

veranderings.na: Om te verstaan en saam te voel deur jou
veranderings.rede: The bare verbs make a fragment; the 'Om te ...' form is grammatical and matches the deernis definition.

veranderings.voor: vir iemand wat swaarkry te voel
veranderings.na: vir iemand wat swaarkry, te voel
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause makes the sentence easier to parse and matches the lesson's own style ('waarop jy gehoop het, nie gebeur nie').

vlae.teks: Sê dit juis dan vir 'n grootmens wat jy vertrou.
vlae.rede: 'dit' has no clear antecedent in this block (the fire? the friend's grief? that the friend is struggling?); fixing it means choosing what the learner must tell, which is content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
